# API routes

> Every REST route the versioned API serves — method, path, view, access rule, parameters and summary — read from the DRF router and `src/api/v1/urls.py`.

Paths are relative to the API host. The canonical base is `/api/v1/`. The root URLconf also mounts the same URLconf at `/api/` as a legacy alias. The router also accepts a format suffix (for example `.json`) on each route; those variants are not listed. `Access` names the permission classes DRF applies (`public`: none). `Params` lists the query parameters and body fields the handler itself reads; list routes also take the filters and search fields in **Resources**.
